label: Stadtarchiv Nürnberg correspondence on Weigel and publishing succession

sources.note: Raw email and addresses not redistributed.

notes: Warns of name confusion among Weigel family members and reports a business succession involving the Weigel widow/family, Barbara Sibylla, Martin Tyroff, Johann David Tyroff and later owners. Also reports relatively few explicit Weigel archival records and notes that many records name him only as publisher.

sources.note: Use as a research map, not a substitute for imprint/archival verification.

notes: Reported sequence: business continued by Weigel widow/family; Barbara Sibylla married Martin Tyroff in 1729; Tyroff operated under a Weigel-widow imprint before the ältere Weigelsche Kunst-Handlung form; later Johann David Tyroff. Model as dated agent/firm relationships rather than one normalised publisher string.
